title: Clash Arena Drafting and Release Date Id/Ego Sorting

texts: Added a point system to the drafting phase of Clash Arena, so players can't always pick the best identities. A setting is provided to let people disable this if they want to.
Added small warnings to all minigames that multiplayer games may be interrupted whenever the server restarts for updates.
Added the release date info to Identities/E.G.Os stats in their respective Advanced Compare Modes and enabled sorting using them.
Enabled Icons Only display mode for both Advanced Compare Modes.
